name: Selangor Marathon 2026
short_description: Selangor Marathon 2026 (SELMAR 2026) is a full and half marathon event held on November 1, 2026, in Cyberjaya, Selangor, Malaysia.
ai_summary: The Selangor Marathon 2026 (SELMAR 2026) is a full marathon organized by Tourism Selangor, scheduled for November 1, 2026. The race takes place at Persiaran Flora in Cyberjaya, Selangor, Malaysia, and offers both a full marathon (42.195 km) and a half marathon (21.1 km) distance. Registration for the event is currently open.
pros: Offers both full marathon (42.195 km) and half marathon (21.1 km) distance options
Registration is currently open, giving runners time to plan and prepare
Organized by Tourism Selangor, a recognized regional tourism body
Held at a dedicated venue, Persiaran Flora in Cyberjaya, Selangor
research_highlights: SELMAR 2026 offers four distances: full marathon (42km), half marathon (21km), 10km and 5km, plus a Kids Dash category.
The race takes place on Sunday, 1 November 2026 at Persiaran Flora, Cyberjaya, Selangor — a move from the 2025 edition's venue at the Sepang International Circuit.

Race pack/kit collection is scheduled for Friday 29 October (11:00am–7:00pm) and Saturday 30 October 2026 (10:00am–3:00pm), with runners required to bring a confirmation slip with QR code plus ID/passport.
Entry is restricted to participants aged 18 and above for the main race categories, with parental consent required for the Fun Run for those aged 6-17.
Pacers and external support crew are strictly prohibited, and support from friends/family is only allowed at official checkpoints.
research_watchouts: All entry fees are stated as non-refundable and non-transferable, and race entries cannot be transferred to another runner.
The final race route was not published in advance and organizers stated it would only be released two weeks before the event.

No independent runner reviews or race reports for SELMAR (2025 or 2026 edition) were found at the time of this search — coverage is currently limited to organizer/registration listings rather than participant accounts.

faqs.question: When is the Selangor Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Selangor Marathon 2026, also known as SELMAR 2026, is scheduled to take place on November 1, 2026. It is organized by Tourism Selangor and will be held in Cyberjaya, Selangor, Malaysia, offering runners a full marathon and half marathon distance to choose from.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at Selangor Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Selangor Marathon 2026 offers two distance options for participants: a full marathon of 42.195 km, which is the primary distance of the event, and a half marathon of 21.1 km. Both distances will be run at the same venue in Cyberjaya, Selangor, Malaysia.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The Selangor Marathon 2026 is held at Persiaran Flora in Cyberjaya, Selangor, Malaysia. This venue serves as the location for both the full marathon and half marathon distances offered at the event, which is organized by Tourism Selangor under the SELMAR 2026 banner.

faqs.question: Is registration open for Selangor Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for Selangor Marathon 2026 is currently open. Runners interested in participating in either the full marathon (42.195 km) or half marathon (21.1 km) distance at the Cyberjaya, Selangor venue can sign up now through the event organizer, Tourism Selangor.
